attributes.action: Stop Bonfire Night becoming a week event, and distressing animals.
attributes.additional_details: Current law allows fireworks on almost any day from 7am to 11pm. This leads to weeks of unpredictable noise, causing severe distress, anxiety, and risk of injury to pets, livestock, wildlife, and vulnerable residents. We call on the UK Government to amend the Fireworks Regulations 2004 to restrict the private setting off of Bonfire Night fireworks strictly to 5 November or the nearest Saturday only. Using consumer fireworks on other days during this period should be made illegal.
attributes.background: Restrict Bonfire Night fireworks strictly to 5 November or the nearest Saturday. Private firework use on all other days during this period should be made illegal to stop weeks of stress for pets, wildlife, and residents.

rejection.details:
We have three petitions recently opened which cover what you are asking for in your petition. You may wish to sign one or more of them:

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893

Ban all loud fireworks and only allow silent ones to be sold in the UK
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786349

Fireworks only to be used on Guy Fawkes night with a 10pm curfew to protect dogs
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/786374
